summary_en: FY2027 February full-year dividend per share raised from 20 yen to 25 yen, reflecting upward revision of full-year operating profit guidance to 1,832 million yen from 1,436 million yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Differences Between FY2027 February Second Quarter Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Results, Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast Revision, and Period-End Dividend Forecast Revision (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Hoden Seimitsu Kako Kenkyusho announced an increase in period-end dividend per share for the fiscal year ending February 2027, raising the forecast from 20 yen to 25 yen. This revision reflects stronger earnings performance than previously anticipated.

The company's full-year consolidated earnings forecast was substantially revised upward. Operating profit guidance increased by 395 million yen to 1,832 million yen, representing a 27.5% increase from the prior forecast of 1,436 million yen. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was raised to 1,151 million yen from 866 million yen. The revision was driven by better-than-expected results in the second quarter ending August 31, 2026, when operating profit exceeded forecast by 321 million yen, boosted by strong performance in the die and electrical discharge machining and surface treatment segments, along with improved efficiency in corporate expenses.

The dividend increase and earnings revision reflect management's confidence in sustained demand across the company's key business segments. The revised full-year sales forecast stands at 17,067 million yen, up 2.1% from the prior guidance.
